scope: Source and contract reconciliation only. No tests, build, browser, package installation, credential use, database write, or runtime verification was performed.

commits.change: The owned local-browser inspect_login controller accepts an optional mfa_selector from its injected auto_probe, trims and rejects nonstring, empty, over-512-character, or control-bearing values, then reports challenge=mfa and the selector after top-frame, origin, destination-safety, and current-document checks. A controller test supplies synthetic probe results for the accepted and refused paths.
commits.source_limit: The real autoProbe() in src/lib/credentials/fill-primitive.ts returns username_selector, password_selector, submit_selector and destination_safe, but never mfa_selector. Its LoginFormProbe result type likewise has no mfa_selector. Therefore this controller branch cannot report MFA from the current injected producer; the new test bypasses that producer. This is an end-to-end behavior gap, not evidence that a live MFA inspection succeeds.

commits.change: The completion validator now permits the optional selector only as trimmed, printable text of 1-512 characters; inspect_login data remains strict, so an extra private field or control-bearing selector refuses before fetch. The new route test covers those two refusals.
commits.source_limit: The validator limits shape and control characters; it does not establish that the selector identifies a unique MFA field, belongs to a safe form, or is suitable for an authenticator action. The controller labels it informational and takes no MFA action from it.

contracts.credential_boundary: The extension system of record requires sanitized metadata only and no credential or TOTP code in agent-visible results. The new selector contains no code by design, but is page-derived text and therefore must remain bounded and scrutinized as untrusted data.
contracts.local_browser_wire_drift: The shared LOCAL-EXECUTOR.md completion contract currently closes inspect_login data at origin, form and challenge. It does not include mfa_selector. The extension completion schema now admits that extra field; coordinate the canonical wire contract and downstream server projection before treating it as an established public contract. No cross-repo code or contract was edited in this lane.
contracts.selector_use: The existing authenticator command separately requires an explicit code_selector and fresh approval/claim. The inspection selector must not itself authorize credential or TOTP materialization.
